name: Beryllium-mirror cold surface-figure metrology near 38 K (reported 37.87 K)
plain_name: Beryllium-mirror cold surface-figure metrology near 38 K (reported 37.87 K)
description: Reproduce the temperature condition of the SBMD-3 mirror wavefront/point-diffraction measurement at XRCF; the reported mean specimen temperature is 37.87 K.

sources.citation: UAH, Subscale Beryllium Mirror Demonstrator Testing Support, Final Report 521134-FR
NASA Marshall Optics and X-Ray and Cryogenic Facility

reported_equipment: NASA XRCF / UAH SBMD-3 optical test system

requirements.rationale: Table 4 reports the actual cold mirror mean temperature 37.87 K; cold reach does not prove this specimen operating point.
A calibrated wavefront/point-diffraction optical path is essential.
The reported mirror measurement uses vacuum.
The published procedure permits no specimen gradients exceeding 3 K. Qualification of this bound for a proposed optic remains UNKNOWN until supported.

missing_information: The 3 K maximum specimen gradient is a mandatory requirement whose equipment qualification remains UNKNOWN. The separate published thermal drift limit below 2 K/hour, support deformation, vibration, aperture and optical calibration also require a test-specific plan; no generic 20 K cold-reach claim satisfies this procedure.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
